item.title: Bevo Classic postponed to Sunday, Texas to face Ohio State, Northern Illinois
item.description: Texas will now play a doubleheader on Sunday against Ohio State and Northern Illinois. The Longhorns will face the Buckeyes at 11 a.m. and the Huskies at 1:30 p.m. Originally, Texas was to play Ohio State and Syracuse on Saturday, but the weather scrubbed the game against the Orange.

item.title: Texas' Will Muschamp set to be one of the highest-paid coordinators in college football
item.description: Muschamp's contract is for $8.4 million in guaranteed compensation through the 2028-2029 season, and he'll make $2.7 million in the first season as one of the country's highest-paid coordinators. The man he replaced, Pete Kwiatkowski, was paid $1.9 million in the final year of his contract.

item.title: 'Devastating': Austin volunteers race to save Food Forest before I-35 construction
item.description: Volunteers at Austin’s Festival Beach Food Forest rushed to save more than 90 plants after learning a temporary wastewater line for the I‑35 expansion will cut through recently planted parkland. The community turned out in force to relocate trees, including a 40‑year‑old mountain laurel now set to be moved instead of destroyed. The nonprofit says the disruption could cost at least $500,000 and is seeking up to $1 million in compensation as construction begins Wednesday.

item.title: Traffic guide: Road closures planned for the Austin Marathon
item.description: More than 30,000 runners are expected to take to Austin's streets Sunday for the Ascension Seton Austin Marathon, Half Marathon and 5K, and organizers expect over 100,000 spectators to line up along the course to watch and cheer on the racers.
